parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the code for any OS command execution. The only use of argv[1] is on line 20 where atoi(argv[1]) is called to convert the argument to an integer. atoi only parses numeric characters and ignores any shell metacharacters; it does not construct or invoke a shell command. There is no subsequent call to system(), execve(), popen(), or any other function that would execute the parsed value. Therefore no path exists from the untrusted input to an OS command execution sink, and the claim of command injection is unfounded.
